usedFor: YouTube hosts your videos, and Predis.ai drafts social posts when “Create Content” follows “New Video Uploaded”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Video Uploaded” in YouTube, then “Create Content” in Predis.ai
bestTemplate.why: A new upload starts a Predis.ai content draft, so promotion begins with the video.

watchOut: “New Video Uploaded” is polling, so the draft starts after a scheduled check, not at upload.
